What is the typical hands-on day to day responsibilities for this resource? Review bid specs and drawings.’ Support equipment install, confirmation, debug and training of assembly equipment.

Job Description:Who we are
Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Our Client. As one of the world’s most admired brands, Our Client is growing and leading the future of mobility through innovative, high-quality solutions designed to enhance lives and delight those we serve. We’re looking for diverse, talented team members who want to grow and challenge what’s possible with us.
Who we’re looking for
Our Client’s Final Assembly Production Engineering Department is looking for a passionate and highly-motivated Assembly Seibi Technician
The primary responsibility of this role is to provide technical/skilled support to Assembly Final Assembly Engineering team. This includes design/drawing review, buyoff support, install/commissioning, and equipment start up support.
Reporting to the Seibi Manager the person in this role will support the Final Assembly Production Engineering department's objective to provide high quality, low cost and reliable plant Equipment and control systems
What you’ll be doing
Review equipment specifications and design, identify improvements, conduct vendor buyoffs to confirm equipment functions,
Install equipment, verify safety, quality, and productivity of equipment.
Investigate to determine modification requirements. Implement modifications. Trial and adjust.
Lower cost and decrease project time by confirming safety, quality, and productivity of equipment at vendor, prior to installation. Minimize adjustment time during vehicle trials by performing quality trials at vendor.
Lower cost and decrease project time by overseeing installation by vendor, and facilitating kanban process.
Improve equipment quality and productivity by implementing adjustments, as identified during online vehicle trials.
Confirm quality results by secondary method (Torque check, vacuum profiles, etc)
Install, setup and troubleshoot Toyopuc and Allen-Bradley program controllers
Provide training to Maintenance members on newly implemented equipment
Share Subject Matter Expert knowledge to local NAMC Maintenance and Production Members
Travel up to 50% at times.

Requirements:
What you bring
Strong PLC programming/troubleshooting ( Toyopuc, Seimens, Omron, Mitsubishi, or Allen Bradley)- 2 years
Comprehensive knowledge of PLC’s - 2 years
Comprehensive knowledge of Electrical circuits and Industrial controls- 2 years
2 year technical degree or completion of trade school program (EET or Industrial Maintenance Technology) and/or equivalent work experience.
Ability to read mechanical/electrical drawings
Ability to travel up to 50% at times. (Including International travel)
Ability to work up to 30% overtime when required.
Ability to lift and carry up to 40lbs on occasion
Ability to frequent standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and crouching on varying surfaces.
Manual dexterity to operate hand tools, power tools, and machinery.
Ability to climb ladders and work at heights.
Good vision and hand-eye coordination for detailed repairs.
Ability to work in various environments including hot, cold, or confined spaces
Stamina to perform repetitive tasks and work long shifts.
What you may bring
2+ years Industrial maintenance experience
Knowledge of Industrial Robot programming and teaching
Knowledge of AGVs/AMRs programming and set up
Knowledge of safety scanners and programming.
Knowledge of various industrial controls networking, EthernetIP, FLNet, ProfiNet ect.
Automotive manufacturing experience.

Manage area project planning, implementation and follow-up to achieve KPIs and critical milestones

Responsibilities:
  • Guide the strategy and ensure the ongoing success of UPTEMPO Careers, to advance UPTEMPO’s mission-driven culture.
  • Oversee the full lifecycle of UPTEMPO’s operations, ensuring a seamless experience from recruitment to program completion.
  • Work with universities to build strong partnerships and engagement.
  • Work with employers to identify opportunities and align talent with business needs.
  • Manage the marketing, branding, and recruitment strategy for the accelerator, leveraging social media, speaker series, mentor meet-ups and other innovative engagement strategies to increase program visibility.
  • Attend conferences, events, and workshops to promote the program and build relationships.
  • Develop creative, out-of-the-box strategies to attract top talent, drive engagement, and position the accelerator as a premier career development program.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring clear communication and coordination with internal stakeholders and external vendors, such as website developers, assessment providers, and other partners, to ensure key deliverables are met.
  • Define success metrics and track program performance in collaboration with leadership, ensuring continuous improvement and measurable impact.
  • Work closely with HR and business stakeholders to coordinate the successful implementation and execution of talent initiatives.
  • Utilize prior recruiting experience to build and maintain strong talent pipelines, foster industry partnerships, optimize candidate engagement strategies, and collaborate closely with the recruiting team to drive successful talent acquisition efforts.
  • Manage multiple projects, priorities, and client relationships, ensuring alignment with business goals and a high-quality program experience.
If You Have Some or All of the Following Below, Please Apply:
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 5-7 years of experience in Talent-related positions which include Recruiting and Early Talent Programs, University Relations, Talent Programs, or Talent Management.

  • Experience in Social Media Marketing.
  • Demonstrated the ability to interface with and influence senior executives, coordinate with other cross-functional leaders internally and build relationships with external partners.
  • Proven leadership skills with demonstrated ability to include and leverage diverse perspectives and ideas.
  • Analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other data visualization tools; proven ability to collect and interpret data, and build reports is a plus.
Additional Information: Travel - 5-20% varies based on client and stakeholder needs.

About UPTEMPO: UPTEMPO is a mission-driven organization dedicated to accelerating career opportunities for women pursuing graduate degrees in STEM. title: GIS Analyst
description:
KAYGEN is an emerging leader in providing top talent for technology-based staffing services. We specialize in providing high-volume contingent staffing, direct hire staffing and project-based solutions to companies worldwide ranging from startups to Fortune 500 and Managed Service Providers (MSP) across a wide variety of industries. 
STANDARD FORMAT FOR ALL JOB POSTINGS

We are seeking a GIS I/II level person to supplement our staff during a very heavy project-laden summer. Attached is the job description, which is extensive but we will highlight the ability to work with CADD drawings/experience interpreting technical engineering plans and property maps, including AutoCAD drawings are key skillsets we are looking for.

The initial period of work will be 4-6 months with possible extension. We’d prefer to have a local person but that won’t be a firm requirement.

Position Summary
The GIS Analyst I/II supports the agency’s geographic information systems by creating and maintaining spatial data, assisting users, and producing maps and applications that support operations across the bay, maritime services, public parks, and law enforcement. This is a generalist role ideal for someone with foundational GIS skills and a desire to grow in a public service environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide daily support for Esri ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise Portal, including troubleshooting and assisting end users.
  • Maintain and update spatial and tabular data within enterprise geodatabases, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with agency standards.
  • Converting CADD drawings to GIS features
  • Document and manage metadata to support data transparency and long-term usability.
  • Maintain and update GIS datasets related to:
    • Waterways, terminals, and maritime infrastructure
    • Port property and adjacent city areas
    • Park boundaries, amenities, utilities and maintenance zones
    • Police beats, incident locations, and patrol zones
  • Design, update, and publish maps, layers, and web applications using ArcGIS tools.
  • Support field operations, planning, and public safety teams with GIS data, tools, and analysis.
  • Assist with GPS data collection and integrate field data into the GIS system.
  • Respond to internal requests for spatial analysis, data exports, and custom map products.
  • Perform basic spatial analysis and data queries to support operational and planning needs.
  • Produce high-quality maps and visualizations for reports, presentations, and field use.
  • Collaborate with other departments to gather requirements and deliver GIS solutions.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Geography, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Environmental Science, Urban Planning, or a closely related field.
  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience with Esri ArcGIS software, including ArcGIS Pro, and ArcGIS Online or ArcGIS Enterprise Portal.
  • Solid understanding of GIS principles, spatial data structures, and geospatial workflows.
  • Working knowledge of cartographic design, including map layout, symbology, and labeling best practices.
  • Familiarity with core GIS concepts such as coordinate systems, projections, geodatabases, and spatial joins.
  • Experience with GPS data collection and integration into GIS platforms.
  • Experience interpreting technical engineering plans and property maps, including AutoCAD drawings
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience converting complex engineering plans or land survey AutoCAD drawings to GIS features
  • Experience with Esri mobile and web applications such as ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, and ArcGIS Experience Builder.
  • Familiarity with automating GIS workflows using Python scripting or ModelBuilder.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for querying and managing spatial databases.
  • Prior experience in a public agency or working with government datasets and workflows.
  • Understanding of public safety GIS applications, including crime mapping and CAD system integration.
  • Experience working with environmental or maritime datasets, such as shoreline features, tide zones, or coastal infrastructure.
  • Proficiency in GPS data collection methods and integration into GIS platforms.
  • Experience operating in a multi-user or enterprise GIS environment, including versioned editing and data management.
Soft Skills
  • Strong customer service orientation with a proactive approach to supporting non-technical users.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong time management skills.
  • Capable of managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented, with a positive, solution-focused approach to problem-solving.
  • Motivated to learn and grow professionally within a multidisciplinary, public-sector setting.
